split_policy.primary_axis: release-operations behavior before fixture directory label, generated artifact path, tmp report path, schema path, script anchor, public action label, package bridge label, version label, channel label, warning label, diagnostic label, metadata label, old-mode label, shim label, fallback label, compatibility label, or migration label
split_policy.positive_rule: release-operations positives are limited to hand-authored checked-in contracts for same-major release operation policy, owned release-operation actions, validate-release-operations workflow ordering, update manifest field contracts, channel selection rules, supported stable and candidate release-drill windows, explicit warning/revert behavior, and fail-closed publication boundaries

split_policy.strict_error_rule: missing required upstream artifacts, missing channel artifacts, missing schema fields, missing same-major revert primitives, missing required update manifest fields, missing required upgrade-support report fields, missing package-channel input, unsupported channel selection, ABI major mismatch, runtime metadata contract mismatch, data-format conversion requirements without replay/revert evidence, warning-free preview promotion, silent cross-major upgrade, runtime alternate-path publication, data-format alternate-path publication, and report/generated rows promoted as support own fail-closed strict-error evidence
split_policy.provenance_rule: JSON owner contracts, runbook paths, tutorial paths, schema paths, script anchors, public action labels, package bridge labels, report contract ids, generated artifact paths, tmp report paths, update manifest field names, upgrade support report field names, version labels, channel labels, warning labels, diagnostic labels, revert primitive labels, upstream action labels, workflow child labels, and owner-split routing rows remain provenance unless an owner split claims the behavior boundary
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: old-mode release operations, shim release operations, fallback release operations, compatibility release operations, migration-only rows, generated-only rows, evidence-log rows, manual-only release rows, installer-shaped positives, package-manager positives, signing-service positives, cross-host parity positives, network updater positives, runner-only success, workflow-label-only success, wrapper-only release checks, and generated/report rows promoted as support are canonical rejection, strict-error, absent-support, or provenance-only evidence
